summary: Crown Castle Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $4.5 billion unsecured revolving credit facility, replacing its prior credit agreement. The facility includes a $100 million letter of credit subfacility, with approximately $39.4 million drawn in letters of credit at closing. Borrowings bear interest at base rate or Term SOFR plus margins tied to senior unsecured debt ratings (0.000%-0.375% for base rate; 0.750%-1.375% for Term SOFR). Commitment fees range from 0.080%-0.200% on undrawn amounts. The company may seek up to $500 million additional commitments, though lenders have no obligation. This is a routine refinancing of corporate credit lines, not a special situation.
